items.title: Your first AI agent
items.summary: Your first AI agent is a step by step guide for students who have only used ChatGPT. It shows how to move from chatting with a model to working with an agent that can use tools, save files, and do a job for you.You'll learn how to:Create an account on the Chat4Good LLM Gateway (https://gateway.chatforgoodtech.com) and make an API keyInstall Hermes Agent and, if you want, the Hermes desktop appPick a model and set its thinking optionsTell the difference between chatting with Hermes and using a Hermes botBuild a lead gen bot that finds real companies and contacts, checks them against public sources, and saves the leads to an Excel fileIt also explains what a harness is and compares six popular harness agents: Hermes, OpenClaw, OpenCode, Claude Code, Pi, and Amp. It closes with tips on using agents safely.Made by Jae Lee for the StartSomething student entrepreneurship program at Singapore University of Technology and Design (SUTD).
